name: Bus stop division

steps: Draw a bus-stop bracket: a vertical line on the left joined to a horizontal line above. Leave enough room inside for every digit of the number being divided, space above for the answer and space outside on the left for the divisor.

Work left to right. Write how many whole times the divisor fits above the matching digit. Carry the
as a small prefix to the next digit.
The final

exact.name: Divide with no carried remainder
steps: Draw the bus stop and align the operands.
Divide from left to right, placing each quotient digit above its dividend digit.

carry.name: Carry a remainder to the next place
carry.when: A place does not divide exactly and another digit follows.
steps: Find the whole quotient digit and the remainder.
The remainder becomes ten times as much in the next place; combine it with the next digit.
Divide the combined amount.

zero.name: Keep a zero in the quotient
zero.when: The divisor fits zero times at a place after the answer has begun.
steps: Write 0 above that place.
Carry the remaining amount into the next place before dividing again.

final-remainder.name: Give a whole-number remainder
final-remainder.when: The task requests a whole-number answer with a remainder.
steps: Finish the whole-number division.
Write the leftover amount using r; it must be smaller than the divisor.

decimal.name: Continue into decimal places
decimal.when: An exact decimal answer is required.
steps: Add a decimal point and trailing zeros to the dividend.
Align the quotient decimal point.
Continue dividing until the remainder is zero.

two-digit-divisor.name: Divide by a two-digit divisor
steps: Use enough leading dividend digits to make the first group.
Choose the largest multiple of the divisor that fits.
Record its quotient digit and carry the remainder.
